profile.headline: Software Engineer, Product Owner, and Solution Lead with military background. My strong soft skills foster teamwork and I'm dedicated to empowering teams and driving continuous improvement.
profile.summary:
I am a practiced Java software engineer with additional experience in JavaScript, various JavaScript frameworks, SQL, Perl, HTML, and C++. My recent projects have included work in React with Redux and also writing RESTful APIs (written in Groovy). While I am most comfortable using Java-based languages (Java, Groovy, Kotlin) I am excited when faced with an opportunity to learn a new language.

As a USAF veteran whose experience in the Air Force was primarily on traditional "waterfall" teams, I have a great appreciation for agile software development frameworks. I have experience transitioning teams to Agile, having participated on traditional Agile teams, Extreme Programming (XP) teams, and SAFe Agile Release Teams.

I am driven to learn new technologies and best practices, with a strong desire to help a team grow and change. I have training in working with teams resistant to change, and love to work through challenges and discussions that will move a team forward in their productivity.
